brief:
Israeli airstrikes on Gaza killed 17 Palestinians, Drop Site News reported. The strikes occurred as violence continued in the territory, though specific locations and the circumstances surrounding the operations were not immediately detailed.

Tuesday's primary election results were being counted across the United States as campaigns advanced toward the general election cycle. In a separate development, the West African nation of Liberia said it would receive 1,200 individuals being deported from the United States, part of ongoing bilateral arrangements between the two countries.
title: Israeli strikes kill 17 Palestinians in Gaza
